options.name: definition
options.description: The dashboard definition (plain JSON). Older schemaVersions are migrated; invalid input throws DASHBOARD_DEFINITION with the first issue's JSON Pointer. Change it later with setDefinition().

options.name: registry
options.description: Widget types by name. Default: defaultWidgetRegistry (fill it with registerWidgetType or registerBuiltInWidgets).

options.name: transforms
options.description: Custom transforms for { op: 'custom', name }. Default: defaultTransformRegistry.

options.name: fetcher
options.description: (request, signal) => Promise<unknown>: performs data source requests and owns authentication. Default: defaultFetcher (global fetch, no redirects, JSON only, size-limited).

options.name: allowedOrigins
options.description: Exact http(s) origins besides the page origin that data sources may call. Invalid entries throw DASHBOARD_OPTIONS. Default: none.

options.name: baseUrl
options.description: Base for root-relative data source URLs and the 'same origin'. Default: location.href.

options.name: editable
options.description: Whether users may switch to edit mode; false hides the edit switch and refuses setMode('edit').

options.name: mode
options.description: Initial mode; 'edit' needs editable: true. Change it with setMode().

options.name: toolbar
options.description: Show the toolbar; an object turns items off (variables, refresh, edit, undo, reset, add, json, pages).

options.name: timeZone
options.description: IANA zone for date range presets and the 'Updated' time. Default: the runtime zone.

options.name: businessCalendars
options.description: Business calendars by the name date range variables refer to (business-day presets, date range picker).

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the widget area. Default: '{title} widgets'.

options.name: lazy
options.description: Load a widget's data only when it comes within 200 px of the viewport (IntersectionObserver).

options.name: retries
options.description: GET retries on network errors, timeouts, 408, 429, and 5xx, with exponential backoff and jitter (integer 0 to 5).

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages, numbers, and times.

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction of the grid, toolbar, tabs, and drawers.

properties.name: savedDefinition
properties.description: The definition reset() returns to (create time or the last markSaved()).

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: True when definition differs from savedDefinition.

properties.name: page
properties.description: Selected page id, or null without pages.

properties.name: variables
properties.description: Current variable values (date ranges as { from, to } ISO dates).

properties.name: canUndo / canRedo
properties.description: Whether undo() / redo() would change the definition.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: The Dashboard Grid of the current page.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Validate and apply a definition (undoable). Loaded data of unchanged sources is kept. Throws DASHBOARD_DEFINITION when invalid.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Migrate and validate a candidate definition without applying it.

methods.name: markSaved
methods.description: Make the current definition the one reset() returns to (call after storing it).

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Switch mode; 'edit' needs editable. Emits aui-mode-change.

methods.name: setVariable
methods.description: Validate and set a variable; dependent data sources reload. Returns false for an unknown id or invalid value.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reload one data source, or every source used on the current page, bypassing the cache.

methods.name: addWidget
methods.signature: addWidget(widget: Omit<WidgetDefinition, 'layout'> & { layout?: WidgetLayout }): readonly DefinitionIssue[]
methods.description: Add a widget (first free spot with the type's default size when layout is omitted, on the current page). Returns issues; empty when added.

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.signature: updateWidget(id: string, widget: WidgetDefinition): readonly DefinitionIssue[]
methods.description: Replace a widget's definition. Returns issues; empty when applied.

methods.name: removeWidget
methods.description: Remove a widget and its per-breakpoint layout entries.

methods.name: undo / redo
methods.description: Step through the definition history (moves, resizes, add, remove, widget and definition changes, reset).

methods.name: startKiosk / stopKiosk
methods.description: Read-only display without toolbar and tabs; optional page rotation (10 s minimum, pause toggle) and full screen. Emits aui-kiosk-change.

methods.name: widgetStatus
methods.description: idle, loading, ready, empty, error, or stale.

methods.name: widgetElement
methods.description: The widget host ([data-aui-item]) on the current page.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort requests, stop timers and kiosk mode, destroy widgets, grid, toolbar, and tabs, and remove the classes it added.

events.name: aui-dashboard-change
events.description: The definition changed (layout, add, remove, widget, definition, undo, redo, reset, import). Store detail.definition.

events.name: aui-variables-change
events.description: A variable changed (toolbar control, interaction, or setVariable).

events.name: aui-widget-error
events.detail: DashboardWidgetErrorDetail { widget: string; source: string | null; kind: string; status: number | null }
events.description: A widget shows an error: blocked, network, http, timeout, too-large, parse, transform, options, unknown-type, or render. Never contains response bodies.

events.name: aui-widget-select
events.description: A user selected a row or list item in a widget; the widget's interactions have set their variables.

contentAreas.name: host children
contentAreas.description: The dashboard appends its toolbar, page tabs, and grid to the host; leave the host otherwise empty.

contentAreas.name: widget body
contentAreas.description: Each widget type renders into .aui-dashboard-widget__body through WidgetContext.body; custom types own that element's children.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-root
cssClasses.description: Host; modifiers aui-dashboard-root--editing and aui-dashboard-root--kiosk; data-aui-density and data-aui-accent from the definition style.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-root__grid | __pages
cssClasses.description: Grid host and page tabs host.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-toolbar | __variables | __variable | __actions | __button | __edit
cssClasses.description: Toolbar parts; data-aui-variable on each variable control.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-widget
cssClasses.description: Widget host (also aui-widget); data-aui-item, data-aui-status, data-aui-tone, and the style attributes data-aui-accent, -surface, -border, -shadow, -header, -density, -padding.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-widget__body | __state | __message | __retry | __footer
cssClasses.description: Renderer area, state overlay (role=status, role=alert for errors), retry button, and the 'Updated' footer (data-aui-stale when stale).

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-kiosk
cssClasses.description: Kiosk bar with the pause toggle and exit button.

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-builder | __form | __json | __group | __field | __message
cssClasses.description: Builder and JSON editor content inside the Drawer (dashboard/builder).

cssClasses.name: aui-dashboard-list | aui-dashboard-text | aui-dashboard-kpi | aui-dashboard-chart | aui-dashboard-table
cssClasses.description: Containers of the built-in widget types (dashboard/widgets).

iconSlots.name: toolbar refresh, undo, redo, reset, add, JSON
iconSlots.default: refresh, undo, redo, close, plus, code
